Method of Attack: Automates ransomware distribution throughout a Windows domain using Active Directory group policies
Creates new group policies on the domain controller to disable Microsoft Defender real-time protection and launch ransomware
Uses Windows Active Directory APIs to perform LDAP queries to get list of computers
Copies ransomware executable to each device's desktop and configures scheduled tasks to launch ransomware using UAC bypass
Print bombs ransom notes to all networked printers after encryption
Impacted Systems: Windows domain environments using Active Directory
Attack Vector: Execution on domain controller to create and push group policies
Use of third-party software to deploy scripts disabling antivirus and executing ransomware
LDAP queries via Active Directory APIs to enumerate devices
